measurement.note: Estimates use nodes * max(rows, 1) * explicit parameter sets and 16 bytes per cell. They are planning estimates, not memory or runtime guarantees. There is no overall trial-count cap.

split_boundary: Parameter sets may be split losslessly under one trial group. Any row partition requires T045 to preserve prior history and state, rolling overlap, as-of eligibility, and label/split boundaries; chunks must not reset history.
